The individual binders on the right shelf blend into each other slightly at the edges, lacking distinct separation lines between some adjacent spines, suggesting minor fusion or smoothing artifacts.
The objects in the bottom left appear to melt into the floor/shelf base with undefined geometry, lacking the rigid rectangular structure seen elsewhere.
